full_credit: physical delivery in all allocated episodes, including both destinations for every layout
calibration: Accept anchor=1 and full_at=1 only after an actual official measured 1. Preserve earlier failures and label any prequalified witness roster explicitly.

checks: null-anchor reference raw and independently measured numeric spread
fixed action and physically irrelevant camera-reactive action controls
